login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Log in with your e-mail address and password.
login.error: Login failed. Please check your e-mail and password.
login.notActivated: Your access has not been activated yet. Please confirm the link in our e-mail first.

register.title: Create access
register.subtitle: Step 1 of 2: create your personal access. Then apply for your customer account on invoice.
register.emailHint: You will log in with this address.
register.nextStepHint: After confirming your e-mail address, log in and submit the application with your company details. We review it and activate your credit limit.
register.success: Almost done! We have sent you an e-mail. Please confirm the link in it to activate your access.
register.error: Registration failed. Please check your entries.
register.emailExists: An access already exists for this e-mail address. Please log in or reset your password.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your e-mail address. We will send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.success: If an access exists for this address, we have sent you an e-mail with the next steps.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.success: Your password has been changed. You can now log in.
resetPassword.missingKey: The link is incomplete or invalid.
resetPassword.invalidKey: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

activate.title: Activate access
activate.successBody: Your access is now active. Log in to apply for your customer account.
activate.errorBody: This activation link is invalid or has already been used. If you still cannot log in, please contact us.
activate.missingKey: No activation key was provided. Please open the link from our e-mail again.

common.loadError: The data could not be loaded. Please reload the page.

application.title: Apply for a customer account
application.intro: Step 2 of 2: with a customer account you order credit reports and PEP checks on invoice without prepayment. You receive one collective invoice per month. After our review we activate your credit limit and inform you by e-mail.
application.emailHint: We send ordered reports and the monthly collective invoice to this address.
application.vatIdHint: Optional. With a VAT ID from outside Germany we invoice net (reverse charge).
application.legitimateHint: Reason for obtaining credit information (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
application.error: The application could not be sent. Please check your entries.

status.pendingBody: Thank you! We received your application of {date}. We usually review it within 1–2 business days and will inform you by e-mail.
status.rejectedBody: You can correct your details and apply again. Feel free to contact us if you have questions.
status.approvedBody: Your customer number is {number}. You can now order on invoice.

overview.title: Credit limit {period}
overview.hint: The limit applies per calendar month and is settled with your collective invoice at month end. Orders up to {tolerance} above the limit are still executed.

prices.title: Your prices
prices.hint: Gross incl. 19% VAT. With a VAT ID from outside Germany no VAT is charged (reverse charge).

zones.PRICE_ZONE_1: Western Europe (e.g. FR, IT, NL, GB, Scandinavia)
zones.PRICE_ZONE_2: Rest of Europe (e.g. CH, ES, PL, CZ)

order.title: Order
order.noResults: No companies found. Please check spelling or country.
order.referenceHint: Max. 20 characters, shown in the order list and the collective invoice.
order.onAccountHint: The order is charged to your customer account and settled with the monthly collective invoice. We also send the report by e-mail.
order.successBody: {gross} will be settled with your next collective invoice. We have also sent you the report by e-mail.
order.errSearch: The search failed. Please try again.
order.errLimit: This order would exceed your monthly credit limit. Please contact us to raise it.
order.errNotApproved: Your customer account has not been activated (yet).
order.errProvider: The data provider is currently unavailable. Nothing was charged – please try again later.
order.errGeneric: The order failed. Please try again.

orders.title: My orders
orders.errRange: The from date must be before the to date.

invoices.title: Collective invoices
invoices.intro: On the 1st of each month we settle all orders of the previous month in one collective invoice and send it to you by e-mail.

api.title: API access
api.intro: Integrate company reports and PEP checks directly into your software. API orders are charged to your credit limit and invoiced monthly, just like portal orders.
api.modeTESTDesc: For integration: returns fixed sample data, nothing is stored or charged. customerReference TEST-402 / TEST-502 simulates errors.
api.confirmRotate: The current {mode} key becomes invalid immediately. Continue?
api.freshBody: Copy the key now and store it securely. For security reasons we show it only once.
api.error: The key could not be created.
api.docsBody: The interactive API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) describes all endpoints with examples: search a company, get a price, order, fetch the result and PDF.
api.docsLoginHint: The documentation asks for your login (e-mail and password).
api.listError: The existing keys could not be loaded. You can still create a new key.

password.title: Change password
password.error: The password could not be changed. Please check your current password (new password: at least 4 characters).
